versions.content: The implicit recovery shall be provided during startup (part of NvM_ReadAll) and by NvM_ReadBlock or NvM_ReadPRAMBlock for each NVRAM block for the following conditions:  The default data is configured (by the parameter NvMRomBlockDa taAddress or the parameter NvMInitBlockCallback).  The permanent RAM block state or the content of the RAM mirror in the NvM module ( in case of explicit synchronization) is invalid and CRC (data) is inconsistent.  Read attempt from NV fails.
